programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Gerry of Team Psychic's lack of control led to an explosive conclusion when his Cyber Bit Beast blew up. The Blade Breakers were at a loss as to how that could happen so Kenny consulted his trusty laptop Dizzi and made a startling revelation. Someone had managed to make copies of the Blade Breakers Bit Beasts! This discovery leads the gang to believe that new powerful Bit Beasts are being developed and they decide to get themselves in shape for battle. Ozuma and his gang, the Saint Shields, are still eager to test the power of the Blade Breakers' Bit Beasts as well, so they head to the beach where Tyson and the others are training. Meanwhile Doctor B is busy experimenting with various versions of a Cyber Bit Beast with mixed results.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai's classmate Wyatt returns and begs Kai to help him train to become a first-class Beyblader. Remembering the time back at school that Wyatt betrayed Kai by stealing Dranzer and using it in battle, Kai turns him down. Hurt, Wyatt vows to return and battle Kai one day. That day may be sooner than anyone thinks' for the mysterious Dr. B and his team of scientists have finally re-developed the Cyber Bit Beast and are looking for a Blader with the skill to handle it. Dr. B approaches Wyatt with an offer to join Team Psykick, and Wyatt jumps at the chance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Dunga and Wyatt battle, Wyatt realizes he doesn't possess the skill necessary to control his Cyber Bit Beast. This frustrates Gideon, so he commands Doctor B to seek out a suitable candidate for the job. Meanwhile, Tyson is back home practicing his blading and quickly tires of it. The rest of the BladeBreakers, including Hilary, keep harping on him to continue until he gets it right. But Tyson has had enough and quits! It seems the BladeBreakers are finished! Then, Hilary comes up with an idea! She tells the guys to take a day off and invites them to an afternoon barbecue with Grandpa playing the part of the Chef. At first Tyson wants nothing to do with it, but finally he relents and joins in. After lunch, the kids relax by the river while Grandpa fishes. Suddenly he hooks a big one and gets dragged in the water! The kids run to the rescue, however, a group of four new teenagers appear out of nowhere and rescue Gramps. After a brief conversation, our heroes realize these new kids are also Bladers, so Tyson challenges their leader, Kane, to a battle. After a fierce fight, it ends in a tie and the new kids leave. Tyson thinks he made a new friend, but as it turns out, Kane is the leader of the Psykick's and is in cahoots with the evil Gideon!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kane, Goki, Jim, and Salima arrive at Doctor B's lab to begin battle tests for Gideon. Jim goes first after being given his new Beyblade, Cyber Draciel. He battles against a lopsided number of automated Beyblades, including one behemoth the size of a football. But with Cyber Draciel in tow, victory is decisive. It's obvious however, that the Cyber Bit-Beast's power is having a corrupting influence on Jim. At Mr. Dickenson's office, the BladeBreakers are blackmailed into a future battle against the Psykick's when Doctor B threatens an all-out assault on the city by the Cyber Bit-Beasts. When Tyson hears that his new friend Kane has joined the Psykick's, he refuses to believe it without concrete proof.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After seeing the power of the Cyber Bit Beasts in Team Psykick's Beyblades, Tyson vows to do whatever it takes to beat them. Even if that means breaking the rules and modifying his own Beyblade. Ray protests and demands that the BladeBreakers play fair even if the odds are against them. In a quiet moment down by the river he runs into Salima of Team Psykick and discovers she feels the same way as he does. Salima tries to convince Ray to get the BladeBreakers to forfeit their upcoming match and even offers to reveal the secrets of the Cyber Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is so determined to beat the Psykick's in an upcoming battle that he's ordered Kenny to modify his Dragoon beyond legal specifications. But because his blade now has too much offensive power, Tyson is unable to control it and he becomes totally frustrated with himself and his blade. The more he tries controlling it, the worse he becomes. His friends try to tell him 'cheating' isn't the way to win, yet Tyson ignores them and being pigheaded as he is, he goes off to sulk about his dilemma.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers travel by helicopter to their re-match against the Psykick's. During the flight, Hilary remembers how Psykick trapped her and Kenny on a cargo ship; Max ponders their recent training; Kai regrets the Psykick' mistreatment of Wyatt;; Ray recalls the time Salima reached out to him; and Tyson remains bitter about Kane joining Psykick. When they arrive at the battle location - a five-story, monolithic building called 'The Battle Tower' - they're greeted by Gideon via video screen, who outlines the format. On each floor, one Psykick awaits a different Blade Breaker, and each match will be a one-match-only sudden death battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Max Takes One For The Team
programme.desc: The first battle between Team Psykick and the Bladebreakers has begun! Max fights bravely against Jim and Cyber Draciel' and his teammates aren't the only ones interested in the outcome of the battle. Dr. B and Gideon watch from the sidelines, and the Saint Sheilds are there to watch their backs. Max defeats Jim, but amazingly, Cyber Draciel is repaired!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Bigger The Cyber-Driger, The Harder It Falls
programme.desc: A confused and heartbroken Ray must face Salima in a dangerous challenge of Drigers! Despite the threat of losing his bit-beast forever, Ray hesitates' baffled by the extreme change in Salima's personality. It wasn't long ago that she confided in Ray and told him of the troubling bit-beast experiments being conducted by the Psykick's' and now' it looks like she's in the same boat as Goki and Jim! Mind-Controlled by their own cyber-bit-beasts! But Ray can't stand back for long' not after realizing his team is depending on him' and even in the face of team Psykick's blatant cheating' Ray refuses to back down' he's not just fighting for a win' he's fighting to bring back the Salima he once knew!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Thanks to Ray's spectacular victory over Salima, the Bladebreakers reach the fourth level of Gideon's Battle Tower and meet their next opponent, Goki of the Psykick's. As Kai steps forward to meet the challenge Gideon and Doctor B prepare several surprises for the team. Using the information gathered from the previous two Beybattles, Doctor B has programmed Driger and Draciel's attack patterns into Goki's Beyblade. Meanwhile, the Saint Shields continue to explore the Psykick's headquarters in an attempt to find Max's captured Draciel.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Meanwhile, Ozuma and his gang have barged into the laboratory complex to help Tyson, however, because the building is so massive, they can't find the right room! They frantically split up and race to find their friends. Back in the battle, Tyson's words have hit a chord with Kane and he decides not to call out the Cyber Dragoon to fight for him. Instead, he wants to win it on his own. Gideon and Doctor B are incensed, but because Kane wants to win so badly, he accidentally triggers the Cyber Bit Beast to launch and now the battle has taken a turn for the worse as it grows in power' at least for Tyson!!".

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson faces off against Kane of Team Psykick and soon realizes his opponent has an unnatural advantage. Thanks to Doctor B, Kane has a powerful Cyber Bit Beast inside of his Blade. This means that when Tyson summons Dragoon, Kane's Cyber Bit Beast has the ability to copy Dragoon's moves and even improve on them. It's obvious from the get go that Kane's Cyber Bit Beast's powers are developing at an alarming rate and when it starts controlling his mind that's when things really get out of hand. Although a good Blader in his own right, under the control of the Cyber Bit Beast Kane's personality begins to change and when he's confronted by Salima he snaps and totally succumbs to its power.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Cyber Dragoon is blown to oblivion, so is the building they are in and it starts collapsing all around them. Our heroes make a mad dash for the exits when, Max realizes his Draciel is still being held captive in the lab. Max races back inside followed closely by Tyson. Once inside the lab, they meet up with Ozuma and his gang who free Draciel for Max using their blades. Now it's a race to try and get out of the building safely!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After the kids arrive in NYC, Max's mother, Judy, takes them to the BBA research lab where she shows them an ancient rock, covered in mysterious writing. Judy reveals that not only is the rock believed to hold the secret of the Bit Beasts, but an organized crime syndicate is plotting to steal it. A test battle is fought, using a bit containing a piece of the rock but the power it produces is far too unstable. The Blader who performed the test turns out to be Max's school friend, Alan, and the two pals make plans to enter a Beyblade tournament scheduled for the next day. But that night, the rock is stolen. Tyson grabs a bike and sets off in hot pursuit, using a practice blade to blow out the getaway car's tire. The thieves take off on foot and Max runs into them only to discover that his pal, Alan, is in on the plot.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Bad Seed In The Big Apple
programme.desc: Alan tells Max that if Max wins, he'll explain why he agreed to steal the rock with a bunch of shady thieves. The battle is heated and Max is determined to win. After one draw and several close calls, Max finally wins. In the end Alan explains that he was approached by some underworld characters who convinced him if he stole the rock they would give him a new, more powerful Beyblade . But the new blade turns out to be a dud and Alan is left to explain why he did what he did to Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Get A Piece Of The Rock
programme.desc: When the kids return to Japan accompanied by Judy, they are taken to an abandoned research facility where Mr. Dickenson had once worked on a similar rock with his old partner, Dr. Zagart. Like the one that was stolen from the BBA, this rock was covered in mysterious writing and possessed strange powers. Unfortunately, it too disappeared, along with Dr. Zagart who was never seen again. After a battle with Kenny and his new 'Einstein' Beyblade, Tyson realizes he still has to learn how to control his new, ultra-powerful Beyblade, Dragoon V2. While practicing down by the river, he is challenged to a battle by Ozuma and the Saint Shields. Tyson accepts and manages to hold his own until the entire Saint Shields clan gangs up on him. It looks like all is lost until a mysterious stranger steps in to save the battle and the day. But the Saint Shields vow to return and fulfill their mission to capture and seal the four Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Attack Of The Rock Bit Beast
programme.desc: Mr. Dickenson and Max's Mom show up at Tyson's dojo empty-handed. Dr. Zagart and the mysterious rock have vanished without a trace. Knowing Dr. Zagart is the key to finding the missing rock, the BladeBreakers decide to launch their own search. One problem, they have no idea where to start looking. Meanwhile Dr. Zagart and Dr. K have designed a new powerful Blade using the rock, and they've chosen a Blader named Foxy to challenge our heroes. While Tyson is busy with Zeo, the boy he met the day before when he fought Ozuma, Foxy attacks. Never one to turn down a challenge Ray follows Foxy into the woods. Foxy's rock powered Blade nearly destroys Ray's Blade but Tyson shows up in the nick of time and coaches Ray to victory. The BladeBreakers congratulate Ray on his victory but the Saint Shields also witnessed the battle. Intrigued, Ozuma vows more than ever to get the BladeBreakers four Bit Beasts!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In the quiet after Foxy's storm, the BladeBreakers try to figure out who or what was behind his attack, and how it all tied into the mysterious Rock. Meanwhile, Tyson reaches a breaking point, discouraged and upset by the constant attempts of fanatic groups trying to steal the sacred bit-beasts. His anxiety goes overboard when he coaxes Kenny to create a wacky training platform for the team to practice with. He takes his jaded attitude out on Zeo, who simply wants to spar with one of the greats. At the same time, The Saint Shields' frustration level also grows, as Ozuma decides that the Bladebreakers are unworthy of possessing the sacred bit-beasts any longer. Tyson remembers the simple joys of Beyblading when he finally agrees to train with Zeo and coaches him so he can pass his Beyblading exam. The proud feeling that Tyson gets may just be enough to get him and his team through these tough times'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Mr. Dickenson deciphers the words that are carved onto the mysterious rocks and reads the kids this warning; 'Dare not disturb this stone, for here, the Bit Beasts are sealed.' The kids realize that the Saint Shields are part of a clan which still uses this ancient language and they resolve to confront them, even if it means battling and losing their Beyblades in the bargain. Ozuma reveals the history of the Bit Beasts to the Bladebreakers, telling of them of their origin as benevolent spirits until evil men discovered how to control them and use them for their own malicious needs. Since that time, the clan of the Saint Shields has made it their mission to seal the Bit Beasts and save the world from destruction. Dunga issues a battle challenge to the Bladebreakers and Ray answers it with confidence, but Dunga's new Vortex Ape proves too much for Driger. After Ray's Bit Beast is taken, the team goes into training but will they be able to save Driger without putting themselves into further jeopardy?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Meanwhile, Doctor K has extracted a Spider Bit Beast from the rock and gives it to a new Blader named Net whose mission is to go out and capture Tyson's Dragoon. As Tyson races to a Junior Beyblade Tournament, Net cuts him off and draws him into battle. During the fight, Net keeps telling Tyson to release his Dragoon so he can steal it, but when Tyson finally does, Dragoon wins and Net runs away crying. In the end, Zeo absorbs the lesson taught to him by the BladeBreakers who invite him to train with them.".

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: See No Bit Beast, Hear No Bit Beast
programme.desc: Kai is busy practicing his Beyblade skills alone in the park when out of nowhere a gust of wind appears and starts slicing everything to pieces. It turns out that it's the work of Jack, one of Dr. K's Blader's, and he's got a Bit Beast that harnesses the wind. Once the BladeBreakers figure this out, Ray volunteers to fight, but Kai stops him and sneaks out in the middle of the night to battle Jack. Discovering Kai is gone, the gang runs and finds him just as he's about to begin the battle. The gang realizes Kai doesn't stand a chance against this wind Bit Beast because he can't see it. Reluctantly they let Kai fight. An intense battle ensues and Kai takes a severe beating as he waits to catch a glimpse of Jack's Bit Beast. Finally Kai summons Dranzer and spots the wind Bit Beast and defeats it. Defeated, Jack runs off while Kai leaves the rest of BladeBreakers in awe as he walks off into the night.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Goaded by Dunga, Mariam goes off to capture Max's Draciel and finds him battling Dennis and his Bit Beast, Tyranno. Using his new Bit Finder Kenny measures Tyranno's impressive strength and is surprised when Dennis backs out of the battle before using its full power. Unaware that Mariam is following him, Max runs off in pursuit of Dennis and finds himself deep in the bowels of a mysterious building. He is ambushed by Dennis- who is now backed up by Dr. K and her Technicians. Mariam lies in wait, planning on taking Draciel once Tyranno weakens him. But when she discovers that Dr. K is using Power Injection to make Tyranno even stronger, Mariam launches Sharkrash and destroys the machinery and much of the building with it. It is now up to Max and Mariam to work together to find a way out of the crumbling building. But will Mariam capture Draciel once they escape?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fed up with all the recent attempts by Zagart and others to acquire the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts for sinister purposes, The Saint Shields decide to take action. Having already acquired Ray's Bit-Beast Driger in an earlier match, the Saint Shields confront our heroes again. They challenge the BladeBreakers to a match at an abandoned amusement park. The BladeBreakers know that if they lose, The Saint Shields will seal their Bit Beasts away forever in a mysterious rock to prevent them from being used for evil.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Fate Of The Spark Battle
programme.desc: But just when things start to heat up, Ray launches his blade to try to even the score. As the battle rages, the roller coaster collapses around all the blades and it appears our heroes are done for, especially since Ray is fighting without his Driger! But Ray is determined not to lose again and using his amazing powers of concentration, he's able to release his Bit Beast from the rock and with it, Ray and Kai defeat their opponents. The battle ends in victory just as Ozuma, who is furious, steps up and warns Tyson his Dragoon will be the next to be sealed!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Ozuma, leader of the Saint Shields gang makes a final play for the BladeBreakers four Bit Beasts. During his battle with Tyson, it is revealed that he comes from an ancient group that is sworn to capture and contain all the Bit Beasts in the world. Thus protecting them from falling into the wrong hands and being used for evil purposes. However, once the battle heats up Ozuma's jealousy of Tyson's Beyblading skill takes him over. Pulling out all the stops, he forces Tyson to decide to give up the battle and surrender his Bit Beast or have his Blade destroyed. In a quiet moment of reflection, Tyson communicates with Dragoon and they decide to fight the good fight no matter what the result. Tyson and Dragoon lock horns with Ozuma's Bit Beast and weave a path of destruction on the playing field. When the dust settles the match is declared a tie and Ozuma realizes that Tyson and the BladeBreakers are worthy enough to look after the four Bit Beasts on their own. The Saint Shields say their goodbyes and walk away content that the four Bit Beasts are in good hands!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Pleased that the Saint Shields no longer wish to seal the four Bit Beasts, Dr. K gives a new Blader, Denny, a powerful rock Bit Beast named Clarken and orders him to capture the four Sacred Bit Beasts. Meanwhile, Zeo catches up with the Bladebreakers and shows them his invitation to the upcoming World Championships.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BladeBreakers show up at the World Championship Tournament and go up into the stands to cheer on Zeo who's fighting in the preliminaries. Tyson is pumped watching his new friend who wins his first fight with ease. Later backstage, Tyson tells Zeo he's totally impressed and asks if Zeo would like to become his training partner. Zeo excitedly agrees. Meanwhile back at Zagart's lab, Doctor K is on the verge of removing the strongest Bit Beast in the world from the rock. But just before she can finish, Zagart enters and terminates her on the spot. That night at Zeo's house, his dad returns from work. The shocker here is, guess who his dad is? That's right, Zagart!! And what's worse, an angry Doctor K shows up to confront her former boss in his house and as she does, Zeo overhears the entire conversation. Now Zeo realizes it's his dad who's been after the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts and his world is thrown into chaos!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Zeo focuses on Beyblade training with his father Zagart. The most powerful rock Bit-Beast named Cerberus is designated for Zeo, but he must first be able to summon it. Zeo trains furiously, but the elusive Bit Beast never fully materializes. Meanwhile, the Bladebreakers must choose their two team-pairs for the World Beyblade Championships. Hilary brings in a pile of her fortune-telling books to help. They decide that Tyson will team with Max, and Kai with Ray. Not long afterward, Kai meets a strange pair named King and Queen, who are very impressed by Dranzer. They talk Kai into battling them, with Dranzer's attack ring up for grabs if they win. To Kai's surprise, not only do they have Bit Beasts of their own, but they're not above tag-teaming him to avoid defeat. By the end of the battle, Dranzer is so damaged that its attack ring is useless, which sends King and Queen on their way empty-handed. When Kai discusses the incident with his BladeBreaker teammates, it's discovered that King and Queen are infamous 'parts hunters' - Blader's who search for high-end Beyblade parts from others that they can acquire for themselves. Back at Zagart's lab, Zeo tries summoning Cerberus one last time ' and succeeds. Cerberus is a massively powerful canine Bit Beast with three snarling heads. Zeo can't wait to use it against the Bladebreakers to acquire their Bit Beasts, which are necessary to fulfill his mysterious and still-unrevealed destiny.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: While all that the Bladebreakers can think of are the finals, Kai can't stop obsessing about King and Queen. With a brand new Beyblade crafted for him by Max, Kai longs for a rematch. But Kai isn't the only one with the royal pair on his mind. Doctor K tracks the duo down and offers them a chance to team up with her so they can capture and wield the power of the four sacred Bit Beasts together. The pair blow her off, interested only in their quests for stealing the perfect Beyblade parts. That is, until they meet up with Kai once more. In a coincidental encounter, Kai gets his wish for revenge. But before he tastes victory, the two disappear! Who knows where they'll turn up again but chances are good, Doctor K. won't be too far behind'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After disappearing thirty years ago, Zagart confronts Mr. Dickenson, forcing him to enter Zeo in the World Championship Finals. He reveals that Zeo is his son and that he won't show mercy when he confronts the Bladebreakers in the tournament. The Bladebreakers try to attend Zeo's match so they can find out what's happened to him but arrive at the arena too late. Meanwhile, Dr. K works with King and Queen to improve their powers so they can get the four sacred Bit Beasts for her. At the opening night gala, the final pairings are announced but tensions reach a boiling point when King and Queen start a no-rules Beyblade match with Dunga. The Bladebreakers manage to stop the duel, but the damage has already been done. The Beyblade finals will be a far more dangerous affair than last year. A grim Zeo looks down on the other finalists determined to win at all costs.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade World Championship Finals are underway and eight teams convene to compete for the title. The BladeBreakers are shocked to see that their old friend Zeo is in the competition and Tyson confronts him to find out why he has decided to compete against them. It turns out that Zeo is the son of Zagart, an old colleague of Mr. Dickenson's who stole the ancient rock that contained captured Bit Beasts. Zagart has already made it known to the BladeBreakers that he wants their Bit Beasts and he's going to use Zeo to get them. Once the competition begins, Zeo's team member Gordo makes short work of Dunga. Then it's Zeo turn. He goes up against Ozuma and it is clear to everyone watching that Zeo's Blade is no ordinary Beyblade. After a very intense battle Zeo defeats Ozuma surprising the entire audience and putting him in a position to move on to the next round where his team will battle the BladeBreakers!!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Did Walt Kill His Ex? The Polygraph (Pt 2)

Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The drama continues as Dr. Phil goes on the hunt for con artists who cheat viewers out of thousands of dollars by posing as him and Robin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Driven To Try And Kill Her Child? (Pt. 2)
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Mom Tried To Kill Autistic Child (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: In September 2013, Kelli Stapleton and her 14-year-old daughter, Issy -- who suffers from severe autism -- were found in the family van, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Could Kelli have done the unthinkable? In a Dr. Phil exclusive, the jailed Michigan mom opens up about what happened.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Doug and Debbie's once-perfect family has been shattered by the frightening reality that they could lose their 21-year-old son, Brandon, to drugs. Dr. Phil lays the groundwork for a successful intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Football Star Accused: Did He Do It?
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.sub-title: Life Lessons from Almost Dying NEW
programme.desc: Today, Anita shares what her near-death experience taught her about how to live. You’ll discover why everything we have learned through our education system, government, mass media, etc. is the exact opposite of what we should know in order to create a meaningful, joy-filled life.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani

programme.desc: Eduardo Pinto Viloria, Director Regional de Medicina Legal en Barranquilla, es asesinado a tiros en su casa. programme.desc: ¡Anamaria asesina a Lourdes por millones y oculta el cuerpo! Sumida en sospechas, culpa a otra amiga. Condenada a 38 años, logra casa por cárcel. ¡Escapa del brazo de la ley!

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Luís Francisco habla con Augusto, y le confiesa que todavía sigue enamorado de su esposa. Augusto, enfurecido al saber esto le dice que no lo quiere volver a ver. Luego, Luís Francisco habla con su madre, y ella le propone que tome lo que le pertenece de los Talamonti, y lo presiona por la deuda que tiene con un banco Italiano, pero él solamente quiere recuperar a Clemencia. De todos modos, Amada piensa encargarse de que los acreedores del banco Italiano le vayan a cobrar la deuda.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: La muerte imprevista de Diego sembró un dolor durísimo en Daniela, pero también dejó a la luz que las sospechas de su deceso recayeran sobre Pedro, quien continúa moviendo las fichas en las vidas de todos los vecinos del condominio. Tanto es así, que luego de que la autopsia determinara “muerte natural”, intenta convencer a Daniela para que no venda el apartamento. Ella no podrá afrontar el costo mensual por el crédito bancario que con su marido habían sacado para comprarlo, y Pedro le ofrece un préstamo. Con esto, y ante la inminente seguridad de que tampoco podrá pagárselo, querrá quedarse con el apartamento.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Todo el mundo comienza a preguntar y Freddy es el que le dice a todos que esa pareja está empatada. Briggite está que se muere y comienza a preguntar que como es eso de que Yubileisy está empatada con su Whisky. Bienvenida sigue diciéndoles cosas a Yubiri y a Wilker. Ellos están pensando en ellos y Briggite totalmente fuera de lugar. Freddy y Solymar están afuera de la casa de Bienvenida hablando de lo mismo. Freddy le dice que es su héroe. Todos se van y se queda Yubiri con Briggite.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta se entera que no es hija de Ana Belén, por unos registros del hospital donde nació. Efraín y Ana Belén tratan de calmarla, pero no lo logran. Julieta se decide a irse de la casa, y Seis nueve le ofrece quedarse con Dilenis. Al día siguiente, Julieta se encuentra con Patricia, una monja que había ido a hacer un informe a ese barrio, y dos muchachos aparecen para acosarlas. Efraín habla con Valentina, para contarle lo sucedido, y ella le asegura que no fue quien le confesó eso a Julieta, cuando justo llega Ana Belén para hablar con Valentina. Nayarí decide contarle a Deibis que su tío es Gabriel León, pero a Deibis sólo le cae mal la noticia, ya que se había cruzado una vez con él, y no lo trató bien.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín intenta huir del país con Hortensia y Glorita, pero es arrestado en el aeropuerto por las autoridades y Ricardo. Katiuska queda al frente del emporio Tarifa. Romina persuade a María del Pilar de fingir su embarazo para casarse con Marcelo. Amparo defiende la inocencia de Benjamín, mientras Ricardo recrimina a Manuela por no avisarle sobre Glorita. La tensión aumenta tras la captura de Benjamín, quien niega su verdadera identidad ante la policía.

programme.title: Episodio 98
programme.desc: Eustoquio roba documentos clave del despacho de Rivero para vengarse de Erasto. Alejandro nota a Leticia extraña y vuelve con la policía. Carlos asombra a Alejandro con conocimientos de amor sin unión física. Rosa confiesa a Carmen Rosa que se casó con Junior y ella se horroriza al saber que es su hermano. Consuelo enfrenta a Erasto reprochándole haber regalado una hacienda a Carmen Rosa. Erasto se horroriza al saber que Rosa se casó con Junior. Leticia es secuestrada por dos delincuentes de su tienda.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la caja que ha encontrado Pitufo Bromista? Una capa que perteneció a Wislow, el gnomo mago. ¿Y de qué tipo de capa se trata? Pitufo Bromista descubre que es una capa de invisibilidad. Cualquiera que la lleve puesta tendrá una oportunidad fantástica para hacer bromas… e imagina el caos que puede crear Pitufo Bromista siendo invisible en la aldea. Pero si Wislow se desprendió de la capa, seguro que tenía sus motivos….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una hermosa princesa resulta transformada en una bruja y necesita los bigotes de un gato y la lágrima de un Pitufo para preparar una poción mágica. Azrael, Pitufo Gruñón y Pitufo Bromista se convierten en colaboradores involuntarios y, cuando se produce la transformación mágica, la princesa les libera y regresan felices a su hogar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Antes, en la Aldea Pitufa no había reloj. Sin embargo, el tiempo se ha convertido de repente en algo precioso, y Pitufo Vanidoso elabora un plan para aprovecharse del nuevo reloj de la aldea. ¿Podrán sobrevivir los Pitufos al ataque del tiempo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Corazón De Oro
programme.desc: No importa lo que diga Pitufo Filósofo: Pitufo Robotín, la creación de Pitufo Carpintero, tiene sentimientos como cualquier Pitufo normal. O al menos eso parece… hasta que Pitufo Robotín pierde aquello que Pitufo Carpintero había colocado en su caja torácica: un corazón de oro. El malvado mago Gargamel y su aprendiz Escrupuloso encuentran al pequeño autómata y le colocan un corazón de piedra, lo que augura malos tiempos para los Pitufos….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Pitufo En Rascacielos
programme.desc: Está claro que una aldea de casas con forma de seta es bonita y alegre… Sin embargo, no resulta muy moderna a los ojos de Pitufo Arquitecto. Lo que los Pitufos necesitan es un rascacielos, un nuevo y atrevido concepto que cambiará su forma de vivir para siempre….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos acompañan a Pitufo Lanudo en su misión de esquilar ovejas para obtener lana para la ropa de invierno. Deben superar varios obstáculos, como Gargamel, un lobo y, por último, un pastorcillo que no acepta pitufrutas como pago por la lana. El respeto mutuo entre los Pitufitos y Pitufo Lanudo va creciendo a lo largo del viaje.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Monstruosos
programme.desc: Es la noche de los fantasmas y todos los Pitufos se preparan para la elegante fiesta de disfraces… pero Pitufo Filósofo se hace con el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo y todos los Pitufos se transforman en criaturas horrendas, aunque divertidas. No obstante, el peligro acecha….

programme.title: Peligro En La Aldea
programme.desc: El pérfido mago Gargamel está harto de la constante superioridad de los Pitufos. Decide destruir su aldea de una vez por todas. Con ese fin, entrena una termita para que destroce, demuela, devaste y destruya todas las casas que se encuentre en su camino. Sin embargo, los efectos son mucho peores de lo que Gargamel había imaginado, ya que los Pitufos creen que las travesuras de los Pitufitos son las que están destruyendo su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Bebé Pitufo ha perdido el interés por los juguetes. Ni siquiera las sorpresas de Pitufo Bromista consiguen entretener al pequeño. Abuelo Pitufo propone hacer una visita al Juguetero, el encargado de fabricar juguetes para los niños de todo el mundo. O más bien, el que los fabricaba: el Juguetero está cansado del poco aprecio que demuestran por sus juguetes aquellos que los reciben.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador verá cumplido su deseo de ser un Astropitufo cuando Papá Pitufo le hechiza para quedarse dormido, transformando el paisaje y a los Pitufos en una fantasía galáctica. Gargamel vigila de cerca las travesuras de los Pitufos desde su bola de cristal, pero el hechizo de Papá Pitufo también tiene efecto en él y le transporta hasta el centro de una tormenta.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Amigos De Soñador
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Soñador decide visitar a sus amigos, los Tufos, Papá Pitufo crea una poción para transformar a los Pitufos en criaturas de aspecto alienígena. Sin embargo, los efectos de la poción desaparecen demasiado pronto y Pitufo Soñador tiene que enfrentarse a la realidad de que los Tufos no existen. Está triste hasta que llega un alienígena de verdad para devolver a Pitufo Soñador su carta, ya que la recibió por error.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su búsqueda de algo novedoso, Pitufo Vanidoso se pone un sombrero mágico creado por Gargamel que le deja la cara hecha un adefesio. Mediante una argucia, Papá Pitufo consigue robarle el antídoto al malvado mago, logrando así que Pitufo Vanidoso recupere su belleza.

programme.title: El Amigo Más Pitufo
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo tenía un amigo: Pitufo Torpe. Pero el pobre Pitufo Torpe es tan… bueno, torpe, que Pitufo Filósofo no quiere volverle a ver. Así que ahora no queda nadie dispuesto a escucharle. Quizá Buddy, el apuesto diablillo que ha conocido por casualidad cerca del gran roble, pueda convertirse en amigo de Pitufo Filósofo….

programme.title: La Absopitufiasombrosa Máquina
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa una máquina que hará que los Pitufos controlen el clima a su voluntad.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El chico del bosque y Laconia, la elfa muda y sorda, preguntan a Papá Pitufo que celebre su boda. Mientras los Pitufos preparan la fiesta bajo las órdenes de Pitufina, Gargamel hace acto de presencia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo se encuentra indefenso cuando se le acaban las bayas mágicas que utiliza para sus pociones. Afortunadamente, los pequeños Pitufos encuentran un bebé de dragón en el bosque y con su ayuda….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha tenido una nueva y revolucionaria idea: una especie de carro que se mueve sobre raíles y no requiere que los Pitufos tiren de él. Lo llama pitufitren y hace que la vida en la aldea resulte menos cansada… hasta que Gargamel lo descubre.

programme.title: Pitufo Sabelotodo
programme.desc: Nadie escucha nunca los consejos de Pitufo Filósofo, así que, cuando Papá Pitufo se va de viaje y Pitufo Filósofo cree estar al mando, decide que va a ser el que tenga todas las respuestas. El libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo contiene una fórmula mágica para garantizar que todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa acudan a Pitufo Filósofo para pedirle su opinión. Y, por si las cosas no fueran lo suficientemente complicadas, aquí llega Gargamel….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La nueva obra de Pitufo Poeta va a ser su mayor creación de todos los tiempos, y contará con Pitufina, la preferida de todos, como actriz principal. Los demás Pitufos compiten por el honor de actuar junto a Pitufina. Incluso Pitufo Tímido, que es muy discreto y retraído, es uno de los candidatos al papel. Pero Pitufo Filósofo, que se ha autodesignado director de la obra, no lo ve de la misma manera….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está horrorizado. Sasita no sabe leer, por lo que podría estar condenada a perderse las perlas de sabiduría que contiene su libro «Citas de Pitufo Filósofo». Así pues, intenta enseñarla a leer. Sin embargo, resulta que casi lo primero que puede leer es una fórmula para hacer que todos los libros desaparezcan. Todos los libros del mundo, ¡incluidos el libro de hechizos de Gargamel y los libros de remedios de Ómnibus!

programme.title: Fortachón Y Pitufina
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón descubre lo que es estar incapacitado cuando se rompe la pierna. Pitufo Carpintero crea para él una pitufisilla de ruedas, un invento que le proporcionará algo de movilidad a Pitufo Fortachón. Pero, de repente, el malvado mago Gargamel aparece en escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Bebé Pitufo ha perdido el interés por los juguetes. Ni siquiera las sorpresas de Pitufo Bromista consiguen entretener al pequeño. Abuelo Pitufo propone hacer una visita al Juguetero, el encargado de fabricar juguetes para los niños de todo el mundo. O más bien, el que los fabricaba: el Juguetero está cansado del poco aprecio que demuestran por sus juguetes aquellos que los reciben.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: No es culpa suya. Pitufo Torpe nunca deja de provocar catástrofes, e incluso cuando Papá Pitufo le manda al bosque a hacer un recado, vuelve acompañado de una nube de mala suerte cuya sombra causa infortunios a cualquiera (o a cualquier Pitufo) que esté bajo ella… Papá Pitufo tendrá que echar mano de todos sus recursos para encontrar una cura ¡y encontrar la cara brillante que cada nube oscura debería tener!

programme.title: El Pitufo Galante
programme.desc: La reina Agripina no dejará que su hijo, el príncipe Godofredo, se case con la dulce Priscila. Ella quiere como nuera a una chica que sea capaz de mostrarle algo que nunca antes haya visto. Cuando Hogata se entera y descubre la existencia de Abuelo Pitufo, está segura de que logrará sorprender a la reina con su captura. Por supuesto, Hogata debe atrapar primero a Abuelo Pitufo….

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados mágicos de Sonoria, que le permitirán oír las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, está a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonía comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Viaje Al Pitufo De La Tierra
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado a la Aldea Pitufa. Y los pequeños Pitufos están helados de frío. ¿Pero qué está haciendo Pitufo Torpe con esa extraña roca que ha descubierto? ¿Y por qué está tan entusiasmado Pitufo Minero con su nuevo descubrimiento? Nadie entiende a qué se debe tanto revuelo por una simple nueva roca para la colección de Pitufo Torpe… Al adentrarse bajo tierra, los Pitufos encontrarán peligros y sorpresas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pantano de Greenpeedeepee es el único lugar donde se pueden encontrar unas algas que son el delicioso e imprescindible ingrediente del famoso estofado de algas de Pitufo Goloso. Desafortunadamente, también es un lugar donde te puedes topar con los desagradables Verrugosos. A pesar de que Sasita y los Pitufos le salvan la vida a un joven Verrugoso, acaban siendo apresados por los demás. ¡Pero el Enmascarado Escarlata los salvará! Quizá….

Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Sail Kings

programme.title: Sail Kings

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob joins Capt. Tucker Ersek and his father for a day of sail fishing off Ocean Reef in the Florida Keys.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: On opening day of Missouri’s gun season, hunters from around the state seek ridges and box blinds throughout the “Show Me” state in search of mature whitetail bucks. For Nikki Boxler and the Winchester Deer Camp, it’s no different. With Winchester’s in hand, Nikki and crew play cat and mouse with several mature bucks at Indian Hill Outfitters in Pike County.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Every season, just like clockwork, mission-driven longboards gobble their way across the plains of South Dakota, the cornfields of Iowa, the timbered ridges of Michigan and the cattle ground of Kansas looking for their soulmates in one of the most celebrated hunting seasons in America…the wild turkey breeding season. Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin Leake joins some old friends on board the Fall Line in hopes of scoring big in the Bay Point Billfish Open. This trip will test the limits of all the anglers as the skilled captain and crew do the impossible in hopes of bringing home the prize.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin and Florida WaterSports pro Jeff Lange go deep off Panama City Beach to test the limits of a new battery powered reel. The results are surprising.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Lights, camera, generator, crossbow... Action! This is one wild ride that anyone can have fun on. Come along on this night time bow hunting adventure in Crystal River Fl.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Watch along as Brandon Branch chases yellowfin with the guys from Fishing Florida Charters!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting rural communities that rely on the yearly cycle of wild game harvest.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nobody chases the waterfowl migration as hard as Shawn Stahl of Team Winchester. The Michigan native spends over half of his year running the highways and flyways searching for the x. In this episode, we’ll tag along with Shawn and his crew with their Winchester pumps in hand as they hunker down hiding in fields and timber in hopes of locked wings from ducks and geese.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Overview: East Alton, Illinois is the home of Winchester Ammunition and the manufacturing home of the shotshell plants that build and produce millions of rounds of ammo for hunters, sport shooters, military and law enforcement. Get an unprecedented inside look at the birth cycle of a shotshell inside the walls of Winchester. From hull to primer, shot to wad and packaging to shipping, watch how the most legendary and successful ammunition brand in the world comes to is born and built.

programme.desc: Diego e Alicia brincam de esconde-esconde com Oscar e Oli no Rio das Lontras quando os irmãos Bobo fazem uma onda gigante que arrasta as lontrinhas rio abaixo.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Jacaré Kyra está perdida no esgoto. Alicia usa sua corda de salvamento para resgatar a pobre Kyra.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego e Alicia estão no Centro de Resgate Submarino descobrindo novos animais no oceano, quando escutam um pedido de socorro.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego explora vulcões quando Alicia o chama no vídeo e fala que alguns vulcões submarinos estão prestes a explodir!

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: O coral das iguanas está prestes a começar, mas falta uma delas: Iggy está perdida dentro de uma fria caverna, e as iguanas não conseguem se mexer no frio!

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego pratica táticas de captura quando ouve um grito por socorro: pássaros cuco tiram sarro da ema, porque ela não pode voar.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego e Alicia estão no Rancho do Resgate quando encontram Panchita, a cadela caçadora mexicana. Ela precisa encontrar um prado para abrigar a família.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Alicia leva pinguins doentes e machucados ao Centro Nevado de Resgate, quando seu barco encalha no gelo. Diego e o bebê onça vão ajudá-la.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Jambo! Diego, Alicia e o Bebê Onça visitam a amiga Juma na África e ela lhes conta a história dos elefantes.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Jambo! Diego, Alicia e o Bebê Onça visitam a amiga Juma na África e ela lhes conta a história dos elefantes.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego visita seu amigo Kicho, um indiozinho dos Andes, que adora a música. Seu instrumento favorito é a flauta mágica!

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: Diego e o porco-espinho salvam a piñata!
programme.desc: Diego e Alicia estão na festa de aniversário do Porco-Espinho. Ele ama festas, especialmente a hora do balão de doces, a piñata, que acaba voando pelos ares!

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: A iguana verde e a fazenda de morangos
programme.desc: É época do Festival de Morangos! Um forte vento espalha todos os morangos e Alicia chama Diego para ajudar.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego e a dupla de rãs de olhos vermelhos treinam para o Recital da Floresta, quando Alicia chama de um anfiteatro natural.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego está na África Central visitando Juma, que o apresenta ao novo bebê gorila, o próximo rei da montanha.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego anda de moto quando vê um esquilo voador tentando salvar um sagui pigmeu. Mas o sagui é muito pesado e Diego precisa ajudar o esquilo no resgate.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: Diego e Dora levam o Bebê Monarca ao Festival
programme.desc: Diego e sua família estão no Festival das Borboletas Monarcas esperando as borboletas chegarem para o inverno. Dora avisa que um bebê monarca não sai do casulo.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: O pai de Diego apresenta um bicho muito especial, Louie Solitária, a tartaruga gigante. Louie é sozinho, pois ninguém nunca encontrou uma tartaruga como ele.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: Alicia e Cauda Branca ao resgate!
programme.desc: Há um deslizamento de terra no deserto! Diego leva o veado para longe do perigo, enquanto Alicia checa se nenhum bichinho ficou para trás.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego e Kicho vão para o show dançante dos besouros. Com a ajuda da flauta mágica de Kicho, eles encolhem no tamanho dos insetos para entrarem pelo rio secreto.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: O marreco Willie encontra um amigo
programme.desc: Apesar de nunca ter visto uma onça antes, o marreco Willie conhece o Bebê Onça e os dois rapidamente se tornam amigos.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: Freddie, o morcego, salva o Halloween!
programme.desc: É Halloween! Diego, Alicia e Freddie, o morcego, preparam-se para as "travessuras ou gostosuras", quando ouvem um pedido de ajuda. É a lhama!

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego visita sua amiga Medina no Egito para aprender sobre camelos. Mas o rio está secando e eles têm de encontrar um meio de enchê-lo de volta.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Hoje os ovos de flamingo vão rachar! Diego está na Cordilheira dos Andes indo para o lago Flamingo. E ele escuta um pedido de socorro!

programme.title: Are You the One? Segunda Chance
programme.desc: Os pares perfeitos são colocados em evidência quando uma prova os forçam a demonstrar publicamente seus afetos. A casa toda entra em choque com uma surpresa inesperada.

programme.title: Are You the One? Segunda Chance
programme.desc: Mike se torna o mestre das marionetes quando tenta manipular todos ao seu redor. Cam comete um grande erro que ameaça seu relacionamento com Mikala.

programme.title: Are You the One? Segunda Chance
programme.desc: A instabilidade emocional entre Shanley e Adam parece não ter fim. E enquanto um par ideal demonstra cada vez mais afinidade, outro casal parece estar chegando ao fim da linha.

programme.title: Are You the One? Segunda Chance
programme.desc: O relacionamento entre Cam e Mikala balança. Tori e Morgan retomam a relação. A temperatura sobe quando os pares ideais são enviados para uma missão arriscada.

programme.title: Are You the One? Segunda Chance
programme.desc: Os casais passam por um teste para descobrirem o quanto eles aprenderam sobre seus pares. E Rashida é atingida pelas manipulações de Devin.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Os participantes descobrem a mansão do programa e alguns pares já começam a se formar.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Depois de umas taças de vinho, Ana Clara se solta e atrai o interesse da rapaziada.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Preocupados com os últimos resultados, os participantes se empenham para unir novos casais.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: A casa se divide entre seguir uma estratégia ou o coração para identificar os pares ideais.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: O grupo sente-se revigorado com a nova casa, mas o clima muda quando novos casais são testados.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Uma brincadeira desencadeia uma briga que coloca em risco a continuidade de um dos casais.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Com as opções de casais se reduzindo, o grupo especula sobre os pares que precisam ser testados.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Incomodadas, as mulheres querem ser mais atuantes nas discussões sobre a formação dos casais.

programme.title: Are You The One? Brasil
programme.desc: Uma visita mexe com a confiança dos rapazes, que temem a revelação de histórias do passado.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Pedaços de Vidro de 12 Centímetros no Cérebro. Coágulo Sanguíneo Assassino. Suicida Com Arma. O Paciente Border Collie. Aguentando Firme no Pronto-Socorro.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma médica da emergência fica em perigo por conta de uma paciente violento. Uma dor de cabeça inexplicável pode ser fatal. Um homem com um ferro enfiado em seu tronco é levado à emergência no meio da noite.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Beba Água que Passa. O Braço Vs. o Aparador de Grama. A Garota Doida da Cabeça Machucada. Acidente de Carro de Adolescente.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma mulher é socorrida de um incêndio e tem um ataque cardíaco na emergência. Um paciente esquizofrênico acredita que está com o rosto de outra pessoa e um estudante de medicina não treinado é confundido com um médico e precisa fazer um parto.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O Acidente de Moto. A Triagem dos Quatro Skatistas. O Tribunal Exigiu Transfusão. O Médico Cuida De Quem Precisa de Remédio.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Vida Após a Morte do Pai Baleado. Dois Médicos, Um Ataque Cardíaco. Overdose de Analgésicos. Um Alienígena na Barriga.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Enquanto uma vítima de um tiroteio é levada à emergência, um rottweiler entra no hospital. Um ataque de asma de uma jovem mãe se transforma em uma parada cardíaca fatal. Um jovem chega em coma ao hospital com alergias misteriosas na pele.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem bate o carro em uma vaca e chega à emergência coberto de estrume. Uma mulher tem um corte de estilete na bochecha. Uma paciente diz que está morrendo porque seu coração está partido.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um jovem está com um cano de cinco centímetros na cabeça que precisa ser removido rapidamente. Uma jovem noiva está sangrando sem parar. Um médico que está tratando de presos descobre que um de seus pacientes escapou pelo teto.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma paciente com uma dor de cabeça severa entra em convulsão e em seguida, hematomas aparecem em suas pernas, seu médico não sabe a razão. Uma linda e nua mulher está agindo de modo tão estranho que o médico acha que ela está drogada, mas ela não está.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma mulher vai às pressas para a emergência depois de ser mordida por um cachorro no rosto. Um médico da emergência precisa superar seus medos. Uma mulher intoxicada e ferida por uma queda tem uma parada cardíaca.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem está com um pé-de-cabra enfiado em sua cabeça. A equipe descobre que a tosse de uma mulher é por conta de uma infecção por vermes. Uma noiva não quer tirar o seu vestido de casamento, mesmo precisando de um tratamento para pedras no rim.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um almirante aposentado chega ao hospital e deixa os médicos perplexos. Eles não entendem por que ele fica cada vez mais fraco.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Em um acidente, um saco de gesso cai em um garoto de 12 anos. Quando uma mulher grega chega reclamando de uma dor abdominal severa, a Dra. Angelique Campen fica determinada a descobrir a causa, mesmo que os outros médicos não tenham achado nada.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: A dor nas pernas de uma mulher grávida é de um vírus que come carne humana e ameaça a sua vida e o seu membro. Um veterano da Guerra do Golfo engole lâminas de barbear e uma futura noiva passa o dia na emergência depois de desmaiar no altar.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Os planos do Sr. Drummond para um fim de semana tranquilo, privado e "sozinho" não funcionam como ele pretendia, já que uma tempestade envia Arnold, Willis e Kimberly para casa mais cedo, vindos do acampamento.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O novo chefe de Kimberly presta atenção especial a ela na esperança de conseguir um cargo na empresa do Sr. Drummond.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sem saber que está sendo atraído para a armadilha cuidadosamente elaborada de um molestador de crianças, Arnold concorda em realizar uma tarefa simples em troca de uma recompensa excessivamente generosa de um comerciante "simpático" da vizinhança.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: A "amizade" de Arnold e Dudley com um comerciante local atinge um momento decisivo perigoso quando, sem o conhecimento dos meninos, o homem, que na verdade é um pedófilo, está prestes a agir.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Kimberly impressiona a patinadora profissional Dorothy Hamill com sua patinação no gelo e se torna sua aprendiz.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: As boas intenções de Arnold saem pela culatra, quando seus esforços para ajudar sua amiga deficiente Kathy a se adaptar à vida na escola pública lhe custam a estima de seus colegas e a amizade dos amigos Dudley e Robbie.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Para tentar conter a má sorte de Arnold, Drummond lhe dá um grilo de estimação, mas o "amuleto da sorte" japonês não traz nada além de noites sem dormir, fazendo a casa inteira querer matar o bichinho.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O Sr. Drummond troca de quarto com Willis enquanto ele está ocupado estudando para os exames. No entanto, dividir um quarto com Arnold causa desconforto para o Sr. Drummond, enquanto Arnold se diverte às custas dele.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: A primeira-dama Nancy Reagan dá apoio a Arnold quando fica sabendo da matéria que ele escreveu sobre o abuso de drogas em um jornal de Nova York.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold como Romeu está mergulhado em mais confusão do que Shakespeare jamais imaginou, quando ele é enganado por seus "melhores amigos" para ser o Romeu da Julieta interpretada por sua arqui-inimiga Lisa.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Larry, o brutamontes da escola, coage Willis a ensiná-lo a "se sair bem" com as meninas, mas as coisas vão de mal a pior quando o primeiro alvo de Larry é a irmã de Willis, Kimberly.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O Sr. Drummond, Willis e Arnold dominam bravamente um ladrão que mantinha a família sob a mira de uma arma, mas o policial que o prende fica confuso quando os três "combatentes do crime" relatam versões diferentes da apreensão.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O presente de aniversário de 18 anos que Kimberly ganha do pai - uma poupança - fará dela uma mulher rica, mas seus sonhos de independência podem ser interrompidos quando o Sr. Drummond descobrir exatamente como ela pretende gastar sua "fortuna".

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Arnold, de 13 anos, é convocado para o serviço militar, a reação exagerada do Sr. Drummond ao erro óbvio, transforma os sonhos de Arnold em pesadelos.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Uma breve visita de Ann, a prima holandesa de Phillip Drummond, e o filho dela, Hans, aos Estados Unidos, se torna uma eternidade para Arnold e Willis, que se tornam bodes expiatórios para as travessuras do primo Hans.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Drummond recebe proteção policial de um tipo incomum depois que suas atividades filantrópicas levam a uma ameaça de extorsão de um milhão de dólares contra ele.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
